meta.title: Context compression tiers
meta.description: Adds a Context compression page under Settings with five automatic compaction tiers (gentle, light, standard, aggressive, max). Picking a tier pushes its thresholdRatio and retainRatio into every mounted agent preset compaction engine immediately, so no restart is needed, and stores the choice in <DSH home>/compression-tiers/settings.json. The plugin also adds three agent tools: compression_tiers reads or changes the tier and accepts optional per-route headroom overrides; compression_context reports live occupancy, the tier threshold and the room left; compression_compact queues a proactive compaction that runs after the turn and resumes the conversation by itself. A [context] line at the conversation tail reports the same occupancy. Every tier keeps automatic pressure compaction on, and /compact remains available to the human. Limitations: the tiers are designed for windows of at least 256k tokens (the official 65,536-token headroom caps smaller windows); the plugin updates preset-isolated engines and leaves the host-plane row alone; remove any other plugin that manages the same compaction engines or the two will fight over the policy; changing a tier updates the engines live, but a browser reload may be needed to see the page again.
